title: WWF Free Ecards: A Small Gesture of Love for Wildlife | BHOC
description: Send a free WWF wildlife ecard to friends and family. BHOC Initiative shares a small gesture of care for animals, biodiversity and our shared future.
heading: A Small Gesture of Love for Wildlife: WWF Free Ecards
lead: A message to someone you care about can also be a reminder to care for wildlife and the planet. WWF offers free online greeting cards for friends and family.
author: Archil Jaliashvili

image.alt: Baby elephant resting its trunk in a person's hands on a card inviting readers to send a free WWF ecard, with WWF and BHOC branding.

socialImage.alt: Baby elephant resting its trunk in a person's hands on a card inviting readers to send a free WWF ecard, with WWF and BHOC branding.

sections.heading: Send a small gesture of care
paragraphs: Choose a WWF ecard for friendship, a birthday, a thank-you or a message of encouragement. Add your own personal message and send it through WWF's official service.
BHOC Species & Biodiversity Protection Initiative supports this invitation to care for wildlife. A simple card can bring the subject into an everyday conversation with someone close to you.

sections.heading: Different species. The same biological need: oxygen.
paragraphs: “We be of one blood, ye and I.” This line from Rudyard Kipling's The Jungle Book expresses the shared responsibility behind our initiative: respect for life across species.
One Oxygen. One Health. One Shared Future.
